blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Trace the LMC accumulator and mailbox separately: INP overwrites ACC, while STA copies to storage.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Schedule independent CPU jobs with an explicit arrival/time rule and label every Gantt boundary.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Distinguish processor speed, memory cache and interrupt/OS services when explaining performance.
